title: A platform that watches itself
sub: Film 2 of 2 of Data as software: a platform that watches its own jobs, pipelines and tables, finds a failure, traces its cause through lineage, says what it touches and proposes a fix, which a person reviews and a second person approves. On Apollo 11, a computer built to watch itself raised the 1202 alarm, and people decided. On the night of Monday 2 November, the claims job fails; by morning Genie ZeroOps has traced it, and Sam and Noor take it from there.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look, the platform map of The Inner Life of Data drawn up close. Colour carries meaning: light blue is the platform and what moves on it, gold is an agreement (the contract, the alarms' rule, the document between two systems), red is a failure, amber is a person's turn to decide, and green is what passed or was paid. Apollo 11 is drawn in its own colours, under a black sky, with the computer's display lit as it was.
